library.description: Developer-mode copy of the prebuilt editor bundle. Moodle serves amd/src/editor_lazy.js when JS caching is off (jsrev = -1); it is the same esbuild artefact as amd/build/editor_lazy.min.js and is NOT processed by Moodle's Grunt/Babel pipeline.
